scope.captureBoundary: Core/environment PNGs capture the padded data-visual-frame with primary radio, disabled-selected comparison, output and applicable error explanation. Real zoom PNGs are complete current visible viewport1264x805 physical pixels, not full-page; inventory PNGs are1280x720 default viewport.

conclusions: Every original PNG was opened individually at original detail, including duplicate hashes; no visual approval was inferred from native pass alone.
All six MD3 disabled-selected pictures retain a neutral selected inner dot and show 当前选择:on, consistent with the effective controlled checked value and native feedback assertion.
Three public sizes and both modes show clear empty/selected circle states, appropriate neutral disabled value retention, error outlines/inner dots and complete nearby error explanations.
Actual hover/mouse-down pressed pictures show circle state layers. Keyboard focus pictures retain an independent complete outer ring with adequate sampled padding.
320px and English long labels wrap without crop. RTL places the control to the right and keeps complete output; brand/forced-colors/reduced-motion are scoped to the sampled pictures.
Touch uses a real label tap, native coarse-pointer and48x48 control assertions. Pictures show a complete selected inner dot, state layer and label.

Real200% uses chrome.tabs.setZoom=2; html/body CSS zoom remain1. CSS viewport632x402 and physical PNG1264x805 are distinguished. Selected dot, exterior focus ring, complete long label, disabled comparison andon feedback remain visible; not whole-page acceptance.
No new visual or Demo-feedback problem found within this assigned Windows Chromium MD3 scope.

limitations: Only this Windows Chromium MD3 subset is manually reviewed. Linux canonical pixels, Firefox/WebKit, other designs and full-library acceptance are separate.
Two inventory PNGs approve only the default visible demo; the no-PNG configuration-preservation boundary test is engineering evidence and not counted as a manually viewed image.
Native videos were not reviewed. A single pressed or reduced-motion PNG does not prove transition timing or continuous motion advancement.
Standalone collection density beyond standard is documented not applicable; loading is owned by the form, and Radio has no mixed protocol.
No browser capture/build/source/test/product edit was performed; only new review files were written.
No canonical baseline, verified coverage or lifecycle was established; original reports and historical evidence remain unchanged.
